changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItemLink') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] ( [ScoreUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ScoreItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL,
) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricScoreItem') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricScoreItemLink] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ScoreUid] ASC, [ScoreItemUid] ASC ) end
if not exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore] FOREIGN KEY([ScoreUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[Score] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore] end
if not exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem] FOREIGN KEY([ScoreItemUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[ScoreItem] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem] end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScore] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItemLink_MetricScoreItem] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricScoreItemLink') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricScoreItemLink WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Metrics_ScoreItemLink_ScoreItemUid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Metrics_ScoreItemLink_ScoreItemUid] ON [metrics].[ScoreItemLink]([ScoreItemUid]) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Metrics_ScoreItemLink_ScoreItemUid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Metrics_ScoreItemLink_ScoreItemUid] ON [metrics].[ScoreItemLink] END
